terms.definition: 基于 Qwen2.5-VL-3B、面向 OCR 的 block discrete diffusion VLM
terms.ambiguity_notes: 不是第三方 DiffuQwen/LaViDa-OCR 课程项目

terms.definition: 全局并行解码把文本片段锁定在错误绝对 offset 且不可回滚导致的碰撞/断裂
terms.ambiguity_notes: 不等同于单纯长度估计错误

terms.definition: 每步仅采样仍为 MASK 的位置，已揭示 token 保持不变
terms.ambiguity_notes: 不等于可 remask/revise 的 sampler

terms.definition: block 间自回归且 block 内 masked diffusion 并行解码
terms.ambiguity_notes: 不等于仅在推理时给 vanilla MDM 切窗口

terms.definition: 当前 block 内双向且可看 prefix，但 prefix 不看当前 block
训练/测试均 block-causal，使 prefix 表征不变并可精确复用
terms.ambiguity_notes: 不同于测试时强行冻结 Bidir 模型的 approximate cache

terms.definition: 不缓存且每步重算 prefix 的双向历史配置
terms.ambiguity_notes: 不是默认低延迟 exact-cache DODO

terms.definition: 预测与真值文本的 normalized edit distance，越低越好
terms.ambiguity_notes: 论文未给归一化实现细节

symbols.meaning: 文档图像与可选文本上下文
长度 L 的目标 token 序列
symbols.ambiguity_notes: 全局 MDM 推理时 L 未知

symbols.meaning: 连续噪声时刻与 token 保留率

symbols.ambiguity_notes: 不等于 block 数 B
Sec. 6 prose also reuses B for block size

symbols.meaning: 每个 block 的 token 长度
当前 block 与已提交 prefix blocks
symbols.ambiguity_notes: prefix in Bidir may be recomputed, unlike exact cache
硬件、batch 和长度分布未报告
依赖未披露的层数、KV heads 和 dtype

design_rationales.concrete_problem: 全局 offset 同步错误与未知长度
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: prefix 提供边界锚点并把不可逆提交限制在有界窗口
analysis_basis: analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: 更小 block 更稳但顺序步数更多；更大 block 更快但同步错误复现

design_rationales.concrete_problem: 推理时切块与全局 MDM 训练分布不一致
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: 训练模型把 prefix 学成稳定 anchor
analysis_basis: analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: inference-only blocking 无需重训但在 OCR 上失败

rationale_sources: paper Sec. 5.1, Sec. 6.2 and Appendix A
design_rationales.concrete_problem: Bidir prefix 依赖当前 block 因而不能精确缓存
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: 禁止 prefix-to-current attention 使已提交 prefix KV 不变
analysis_basis: analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: static history 可提速但大 block 精度弱于重算 Bidir

design_rationales.concrete_problem: static history 在大 block 产生 representation drift
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: 每步重算 prefix 使历史适配 current block
analysis_basis: analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: 精度更好但计算与带宽更高且无 exact cache

design_rationales.design: complementary masking and stratified timestep sampling
design_rationales.concrete_problem: 训练需覆盖不同 mask/noise levels
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: 更均衡地覆盖噪声条件
analysis_basis: analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: 其他 mask/timestep schedules 可能有不同方差和难度分布

rationale_sources: paper Appendix B and Figure B2
design_rationales.concrete_problem: 固定 top-k 不能按样本难度自适应并行 token 数
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: 仅提交高置信位置并动态调整每步揭示数量
analysis_basis: analysis.md#32-设计动机与具体问题映射
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: 更高阈值更准但更慢；top-k 易控制步数但适应性弱

limitations.reason: Interrupted range transport produced a PDF whose readable main pages render correctly but whose hash differs from the arXiv ETag and whose appendix has XObject warnings; source gzip is partial and invalid.
limitations.effect_on_conclusions: All counted visuals are individually verified pages 5-7 and text is cross-checked against complete arXiv HTML; source-level claims are not made.

limitations.reason: No paper forum/reviews/decision/rebuttal were identifiable; exact-title APIs returned HTTP 403 and only a workshop-level forum was linked.
limitations.effect_on_conclusions: Review-stage novelty, leakage and reproducibility concerns cannot be cross-checked.

limitations.reason: No author DODO repository or model metadata was found; the selected pinned repository is an unrelated third-party seminar project.
limitations.effect_on_conclusions: DODO implementation/config behavior remains paper-only and the third-party code is used only as an external comparator.

limitations.reason: Required responses-doc document-input capability is absent from the installed CLI.
limitations.effect_on_conclusions: No effect on paper-derived evidence; only the optional explanatory graphic is absent.

limitations.reason: The paper does not report inference hardware, dtype, batch size, input-length distribution or timing protocol.
limitations.effect_on_conclusions: The 5x result is limited to the authors' unreported environment and cannot be converted to portable latency or bandwidth utilization.
